title: Contacts
content: My work is an invitation to collaboration, whether you are looking for a high-performance web engineering technical solution or an architectural vision for your physical space.

ibid. operates from Vila Nova de Gaia and Porto, but our nature is global. We are available to discuss projects that challenge conventions and seek an integrated approach between design, technology, and architecture.
Let's build on what already exists, creating something entirely new and unique. Ibidem In the same place, but on a new page.
